status: DRAFT for review: not executed; no download, training or inference has been performed for C2
task: C2 pilot (protocol prepared under the M2 card)
seed_scope: random, numpy and tensorflow seeds (split reproduction, shuffling, weight initialisation, augmentation); Metal GPU kernels are not guaranteed deterministic

checkpoints.proposed: new training of both models, seed 42 (D-1, agreed by the reviewer on 19 October 2026)

excluded_pooled.reason: per-frame random split of train + test: all 50 subjects on both sides, 235 of the 300 CASIA evaluation images in fitting or early stopping (M2 rules C15, C16)

checkpoints.output_dir: <restricted run folder>/checkpoints (never models/weights: the existing cards and weights must not be overwritten)
checkpoints.reason_source_side_only: existing weights: pre-repository script; seed 42 only for split and shuffling (initialisation not seeded); best epoch not recorded; best weights restored only when early stopping fired (models/weights/PROVENANCE.md, card notes)
checkpoints.pre_commitment: new models reported whatever the outcome (flagged non-informative if degenerate); no retraining, hyper-parameter or criterion change after seeing dev, test or target scores
checkpoints.check_of_new_weights: after train and before any score: file SHA-256 against the card, card fields, restored epoch; existing or pooled weights refused

budget.inference_passes: per model: score --set dev (raw scores; threshold and prediction null), then select (threshold.json), then score --set source_test,target (raw scores; refused without threshold.json), then apply (decision records with the frozen threshold)
budget.on_cap_exceeded: stop, no results; report as a failed run
budget.epochs_argument: --epochs 12 (limit of the existing cards; script default 10)
budget.hyper_parameters_origin: those of scripts/train_cnn.py used for the 12 September 2026 trainings (optimizer, loss and early stopping from the reference configuration), fixed before C1; not chosen on NUAA or C2 data

derived_frames.linkage: frames linked to manifest rows by sampling order and label/group arrays, checked against the manifests before use

preprocessing.face_crop: RetinaFace (OpenCV DNN, confidence >= 0.6, box >= 16 px), Haar cascade fallback, whole image if both fail; margin 0.15, square
preprocessing.enhancement: per-image: bilateral filter (9, 75, 75), CLAHE on L (3.0, 8x8), unsharp masking (sigma 2.0, 1.5/-0.5), gamma 1.2, convertScaleAbs(1.1, 5)
preprocessing.batch_norm: inference with training=False: moving statistics from source fitting only
preprocessing.augmentation: source fitting frames only: flip, rotation 0.03, zoom 0.12, translation 0.06, brightness 0.15, contrast 0.2, Gaussian noise 0.02; shuffle buffer 4096, seed 42
preprocessing.detector_fallback: not available: the caches do not record the detector used per image; a new detection pass would be a separate measurement to be authorised

training.split: fitting = source_train, early stopping = source_dev (GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.2, random_state=42) on the local subject number of train_img; must reproduce the two manifests exactly, otherwise FAIL)
training.early_stopping: val_loss on source_dev, patience 4, best weights restored (also when the epoch limit is reached)
training.lr_schedule: ReduceLROnPlateau on source_dev val_loss, factor 0.5, patience 2, min 1e-6
training.checkpoint_selection: the restored best-val_loss epoch on source_dev; no other selection
training.test_evaluation_during_training: disabled (card without test field): no source-test result before the threshold is frozen
training.device: Metal GPU (not deterministic; evidence = saved weights SHA-256)

threshold.rule: candidates = distinct dev scores plus nextafter(min, -inf) if >= 0; attack if score > value (tie = bona fide); eer: min |fp*n_attack - fn*n_bona_fide| on integers, ties -> highest value
threshold.dev_reuse_declared: source_dev drives early stopping, learning-rate reduction, best-epoch restore and the threshold
threshold.frozen_before_test: threshold.json written by select from dev scores before any source-test or target scoring; its SHA-256 is recorded by score before test scoring and checked unchanged by apply
threshold.selection_code: generic functions of scripts/select_threshold.py imported unchanged (threshold_counts, candidate_thresholds, select_threshold)

metrics.score: probability of attack in [0, 1]; label 0 bona fide, 1 attack
primary: APCER = accepted attacks / n_attack, pooled over all attacks (group convention)
ACER = (APCER + BPCER) / 2 when both are defined (group convention)
metrics.per_attack_type: ISO/IEC 30107-3 per-PAI-species APCER with metrics_by_attack_type; NUAA: print only (equal to pooled APCER); CASIA-FASD: token mapping of the Idiap bob.db.casia_fasd interface (v2.0.9, get_type: 3, 4, HR_2 warped; 5, 6, HR_3 cut; 7, 8, HR_4 video), consistent with the three attack types of Zhang et al., ICB 2012 [DOC-EXT]; assumed to hold for the mirror's file names; labelled
metrics.uncertainty: none: single seed, single split; no frame-level binomial interval (frames not independent); subject-level dispersion in the restricted output only

restricted: raw_scores_dev.csv, raw_scores_source_test.csv, raw_scores_target.csv (threshold and prediction null) and decision records scores_E1..E4.csv written by apply (threshold = frozen value, prediction); research/templates/score-schema.json fields
public: code and this configuration with its SHA-256
threshold.json (values, aggregate dev counts, SHA-256; no identifier; as for M1)
aggregate table E1-E4 with denominators and subject counts

environment.source: pip_freeze.txt of run 20261019-M2-rgb-seed42-cbcda11; lock of the C2 run saved in its restricted folder

run_report: compiled from research/templates/run-report.md at run time

scoring.recomputation: apply recomputes every number from the score files

decisions.D-4: open (D1): NUAA mirror copy accepted in M2 (proposed) or official release; CASIA-FASD agreement in place before the run

known_before_protocol_not_used_for_any_c: card metrics of the existing CASIA-FASD checkpoints on the CASIA-FASD test (incl. EER 0.4504 and 0.6184)
C1 NUAA table (300 images), including the pooled CASIA-FASD rows
local evaluation of 25 September 2026 on the 300 CASIA-FASD evaluation images
evaluations of the same weights on CelebA-Spoof, SynthASpoof and the sample set (September 2026, outside the C1 package)

score_records.before_select: score --set dev writes raw_scores_dev.csv: raw dev scores, threshold null, prediction null; select reads only these
score_records.schema_deviation: before apply, threshold and prediction are null instead of the schema's number frozen from source dev; declared phase rule
score_records.after_select: threshold.json frozen per model; score --set source_test,target writes raw_scores_source_test.csv and raw_scores_target.csv (threshold and prediction null); only apply writes the decision records scores_E1..E4.csv (and the dev for reference) with threshold = frozen value and prediction = 1 iff score_attack > threshold (tie = bona fide)
score_records.fixed_0_5: aggregate table only, labelled; never in the threshold field

run_steps.check: before training: manifests, caches, splits and separation by SHA-256; no detector, no weights
